verdict.suspectedIssue: Bulk discount (minQty 4, 10% off) appears not to be applied independently of the promo code. In turn 1 the cart had 4 items (2×house-blend, 1×single-origin, 1×cold-brew-kit, subtotal $90.00), which meets the bulkDiscount minQty of 4, yet the only discount shown was $9.00 attributed to BREW10 (total $81.00). If bulk and promo stack, the total should be $72.90; more importantly, if the bulk rule applies at all on its own, a 4-item cart with NO promo code must total $81.00, not $90.00. The single observation cannot distinguish 'bulk silently skipped' from 'intentionally non-stacking', so confirmation requires the same cart without any promo code.
verdict.evidenceSummary: Turn 1 mixed cart (qty 4, subtotal 9000 minor) with BREW10 showed discountMinor 900 and promoStatus 'BREW10 applied: 10% off' — no separate line or evidence of the catalog's bulkDiscount rule (minQty 4, 10% off) being applied even though the cart quantity threshold was met. Turn 2 quantity change behaved correctly (1450→2900 for qty 1→2). Price display and cart-count checks all passed.

All required commerce workflows actively verified against the catalog. (1) Mixed cart: 2x Arc Desk Lamp ($118.00) + 1x Felt Wrist Rest ($24.00) = subtotal 14200 minor, matching catalog 2*5900+2400. (2) Promo DESK15 on the mixed cart: discount 2130 minor = exactly 15% of 14200, total 12070 minor, promo status rendered correctly. (3) Quantity change: Monitor Arm Pro qty 1->2 grew count 1->2 and total 8900->17800 minor (8900 each), no off-by-unit or rounding defects. Cart count matched clicks, promo/checkout/CTA interactions usable across mobile/small/desktop, no console errors, displayed prices match catalog for all 4 products. Arithmetic is consistent across every scenario; no discrepancy found.

Mixed-cart scenario (2 wool-socks + 1 rain-shell + 1 field-cap) subtotal 18100 minor matches catalog (2*1800+11900+2600); TRAIL10 applied to the MIXED cart discounts 1810 (10%) for a total of 16290, exactly the catalog rule. Quantity change on field-cap went 4400 -> 7000 minor (1800+2600 -> 1800+2*2600), consistent. Cart count 4 matches item count. All probes (pricing, cart totals, promo, checkout, responsiveness) pass with no console errors.
